notes: Templates use {placeholders}. Analyzer fills them before serving. Times in display text are HH:MM:SS UTC. Tool args still use full RFC 3339.

incident.t1: incident.t1 formatted HH:MM:SS UTC, or t0 when still open
incident.headline: incident.headline as stored
incident.who: incident.who.name if present, else 'the hot frame'
incident.peak: how_bad.evidence.worst.value + unit when present, else a short number taken from headline
incident.type_title: human title for incident.type (optional; not required in templates below)

chart_range.from: range start HH:MM:SS UTC (UI fills from brush; analyzer leaves placeholder in range_questions)
chart_range.title: chart.title
chart_range.metric: primary series metric name for the chart
